title: Blue Queen Suite- Min to Broadway
description:
Enjoy the heart of Nashville @ The Blue Queen suite. Embrace the plush 1 bedroom, 1 bath modern unit steps away from the action on Broadway. The suite is conveniently located 2 minutes from music row surrounded by major attractions, including Bridgestone Arena, Country Music Hall of Fame, Nissan Stadium,  Convention Center, Museum & more. The suite is perfect for families, couples & business travelers with many restaurants, bars & shopping in walking distance. Parking in gated garage is $30/day

The space
The Blue Queen Suite is designed to give you a an upscale yet comfortable experience. The unit has a modern feel from the sleek furniture to the stainless steel appliances. The suite is equipped with a 3 Queen beds a Queen Beds and a camper cot to allow for comfortable sleeping arrangements. Make sure to carve some time out to experience our spa-like bathroom. Looking to kick back and stay in a couple days, we got you covered. Take advantage of some streaming with our Roku Smart TV which includes access to  Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, youtube, wifi and more. The kitchen is stocked with cookware if you desire to dine in. In need of some fun? We have a swimming pool with beautiful outdoor sitting and grilling areas available. For those who need to get fit, visit our 24 hour fitness center including a rock climbing wall and yoga studio. visit our 2 level lounge 24 hrs a day for some quiet study time, work or relaxation. There is a washer and dryer in the unit for your laundry needs. Lastly, the suite is thoroughly cleaned and sanitized immediately after check-out by our partnering company Evans Janitorial LLC. We also include light cleaning supplies for your peace-of-mind. 
Permit#2018071170

Guest access
Full unit

Other things to note
You have to send your email to gain access using the DOOR App System! Parking is an additional cost, it is not included in your stay.
